name: It Came From Above Us
source: Explore a future Tokyo where cosmic mysteries converge with human fate in It Came From Above Us. Join enigmatic scientist Mio and curious high school student Rei as they unravel a secret that will reshape humanity...
translation: 在《来自我们之上》中探索未来的东京，那里宇宙的奥秘与人类的命运交汇在一起。与神秘科学家澪和好奇的高中生丽一起解开一个将重塑人类的秘密……
